technical.summary: Strong trend structure with ADX 40.61 and multiple bullish MAs, but extreme RSI9 overbought (84.42) and lack of fresh crossover signals suggest limited upside room; better suited for profit-taking than new entry.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, earnings in 26 days present timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; all recent trades are small-amount sales by junior members 85+ days old; broad market sentiment neutral with slight bearish tilt; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (268) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 26 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for multinational ORCL.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX 40.61 confirms strong trend structure with three white soldiers pattern and multiple bullish MAs providing technical foundation for continuation.
